shadows.name: interactive-md
shadows.purpose: Hover feedback on primary and secondary controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action with the user's selected accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand-500); color: white; padding: 0.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--brand-500); border-radius: 0.375rem; transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: transparent; color: var(--brand-500); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action that stays visible on dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: white; padding: 0.25rem; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0.375rem; transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { opacity: 0.5; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); }

narrative.overview: AniDev debe sentirse cómodo, libre, versátil y bajo control de la persona. La interfaz acompaña el descubrimiento con jerarquía editorial y un acento personalizable.
keyCharacteristics: Base oscura con capas tonales cercanas.

rules.name: The Personal Accent Rule
rules.body: El acento puede ser expresivo, pero siempre debe respetar la elección de la persona y mantener contraste suficiente.

dos: Do preserve the user's accent-color choice across interactive states.
Do use semantic HTML, visible focus, and readable contrast.
Do keep discovery flexible through responsive layouts and clear hierarchy.
donts: Don't make the catalog feel like a rigid administrative table.
Don't use decoration that competes with titles, artwork, or metadata.
Don't assume one fixed accent color when the product supports customization.
